end.parentNote: Asha practised using pictures to show how a sequence grows and to support why a pattern is true. Ishita used rows, columns, and boundary counting correctly in several examples, including explaining a difference as 9 + 9 + 1 = 19. There was a mix-up when halving the rectangle made from two triangles; it was corrected later by counting 30 dots in the rectangle and 15 in one triangle (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Ishita to draw the next picture in a dot sequence and explain the total using rows or columns.
